solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Express disapproval with uniform dress

parts.note: to tut is to click the tongue in disapproval
U is Uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone sniffs disapprovingly at a dress worn as part of a uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutu is the short stiff skirt a ballerina wears, a kind of dress.

clue.text: Highly intelligent person is after university employment

indicators.note: is after says the clever person comes after the university letter

parts.note: a sage is a wise person

explanation.surface: A brilliant graduate is seeking a job after university.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is the use or employment of something, such as a word.

clue.text: Uniquely wild, keeping expressing feelings loudly and explicitly

indicators.note: keeping means the jumbled letters hold the other piece inside them
wild means the letters of uniquely are rearranged

parts.note: someone vocal speaks out forcefully

explanation.surface: Someone uniquely wild expresses their feelings loudly and openly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loudly' tempts as a homophone signal, but 'expressing feelings loudly' is simply a definition of the inserted word.
explanation.definitionFit: Unequivocally means unambiguously, stated plainly with no room for doubt.

clue.text: Guided round island, certainly having much free time

indicators.note: the guide word goes round, enclosing the other pieces

parts.note: guided means led
I is the map abbreviation for island
sure, as in 'sure!', means certainly

explanation.surface: A tourist is shown round an island at leisure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'certainly' is not a link word here but a piece of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The leisured classes are people with plenty of spare time, not obliged to work.

clue.text: Talking indiscreetly in toilets on ecstasy

indicators.note: on means the ecstasy letter is placed after the toilets word

parts.note: loos are toilets
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone high in the toilets is blabbing secrets.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose talk is careless chatter, as in the wartime 'loose lips sink ships'.

clue.text: What are inside pub on a road south

parts.note: an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: Asking what lies within a pub on a road heading south.
explanation.definitionFit: Innards are the internal organs or workings, the parts within something.

clue.text: Profane? Second nature, unfortunately, when Charlie's involved

indicators.note: involved means the Charlie letter is wrapped up inside the jumble
unfortunately suggests things going wrong, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: C is Charlie in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Profanity becomes second nature, sadly, once a man called Charlie gets involved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' rearranges SECOND NATURE; 'involved' puts C into the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Profane means not sacred, secular, which describes ground or a building never consecrated.

clue.text: Adapted medicine, eliminating one type of disease

indicators.note: adapted means the remaining letters are reworked into a new order
eliminating means the one letter is removed from medicine

parts.note: I, the Roman numeral, means one

explanation.surface: A modified medicine wipes out a type of disease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eliminating' removes I from MEDICINE to leave MEDCINE, which 'Adapted' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: An endemic disease is one regularly found in a particular region or population, as malaria in tropics.

clue.text: Tired and unhappy oarsman back in Canada

indicators.note: the rower piece sits in the middle of the Canada abbreviation
back means the oarsman word is read the other way round

parts.note: an oarsman is a rower

explanation.surface: A rower comes home to Canada exhausted and dejected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns ROWER into REWOR, which goes 'in' CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Careworn describes a face or person worn down and drained by worry.

clue.text: End of fish, end of sea

parts.note: a cod is a fish

indicators.note: the end of the word sea is its final letter

explanation.surface: A cryptic line about where a fish's tail and the sea's edge lie.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'End' is the definition; the second 'end of' picks the last letter of 'sea'.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a coda is the closing passage that rounds off a piece.

clue.text: Someone's skin remedy is safe

indicators.note: the skin of a word is its outside letters, first and last

parts.note: a remedy is a cure

explanation.surface: A skin cream promises to make someone's complexion safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skin' takes the outer letters S and E of 'Someone'; the 's stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Secure and safe are synonyms: protected from danger or harm.

clue.text: Bag regularly found in search

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of search is taken, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A bag turns up regularly during a search.
explanation.definitionFit: A sac is a pouch or bag-like cavity in an animal or plant.

clue.text: English chap Queen returned to give a new title to

indicators.note: returned means the string of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: a chap is a man
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher for the Queen

explanation.surface: An English man comes back to the Queen, who gives him a new title.
explanation.definitionFit: To rename something is to call it by a different name or label.

clue.text: Conservative valley landscape receiving constant restoration

parts.note: a vale is a valley

indicators.note: the landscape word receives, taking in, the constant letter

parts.note: a landscape is a scene
c is the symbol for a constant, such as the speed of light

explanation.surface: A Tory restores himself among valleys and countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receiving' puts C inside SCENE to give SCENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Convalescence is the period of recovery, the restoration of health after illness.

clue.text: Former ophthalmologist is in old religious group

indicators.note: in means the is letters go inside the word for religious group

parts.note: a cult is a religious group

explanation.surface: An eye doctor turns out to belong to an old sect.
explanation.definitionFit: Oculist is a dated word for an eye specialist, hence 'Former'.

clue.text: Even now dressed in passed on baby's clothing

indicators.note: dressed in means the even-now word is clothed in the passed-on word

parts.note: someone who has passed on is the late so-and-so
yet means even now, still

explanation.surface: Baby clothes handed down are still being worn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passed on' looks like 'handed down', fitting baby clothes, but means dead: LATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A layette is a complete set of garments and linen for a newborn.

clue.text: Organ used by Meyerbeer

indicators.note: used by means the letters are found within the composer's name

explanation.surface: An instrument was played by the opera composer Meyerbeer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organ' suggests the instrument in a composer's hands, but it is a body organ.
explanation.definitionFit: The eye is the sense organ of sight.

clue.text: Loud protest exposed about railway

parts.note: something exposed is out in the open
c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A public protest erupts after a railway scandal is exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcry is a strong public expression of objection or anger.

clue.text: Second copy? 'E can make one

parts.note: to crib is to copy another's work
'E is the word he with the h dropped, giving E

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether he can make a second copy.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the wordplay: a scribe is one who can make a copy.
explanation.definitionFit: A scribe copied documents by hand, so is someone able to produce a duplicate.

clue.text: Relish novel cause

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters of cause appear in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys championing an unusual cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relish' reads as a verb, enjoy, but is the condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: A relish is a condiment or tangy accompaniment to food, like a sauce.

clue.text: Publisher's way of advertising obscure book

parts.note: to blur is to obscure

explanation.surface: A publisher promotes an obscure book.
explanation.definitionFit: A blurb is the short promotional text printed on a book's jacket.

clue.text: Complete start of form badly

indicators.note: the start of the word form is its first letter

parts.note: ill means badly, as in 'ill-treated'

explanation.surface: Someone fills in the first part of a form badly.
explanation.definitionFit: To fill in or fill a form is to complete it.

clue.text: Unsuspecting trader uses tariff, unusual externally

indicators.note: externally means only the outside letters of each of these four words count

explanation.surface: A trader naively applies a strange tariff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'externally' takes the first and last letters of each word: TR, US, TF, UL.
explanation.definitionFit: A trustful person is credulous, not inclined to suspect others.

clue.text: They confused empty line with neon for flammable gas

indicators.note: confused means the letters of they are jumbled
an empty word has its insides removed, leaving the outside letters

parts.note: NE is the chemical symbol for neon

explanation.surface: People muddle a blank line with neon when labelling a flammable gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' turns THEY into ETHY; 'empty' leaves LE from 'line'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethylene is a hydrocarbon gas that burns readily, used in making plastics.

clue.text: Couch returned before time for money to be paid

indicators.note: before says the reversed couch word comes ahead of the time letter
returned means the couch word is read backwards

parts.note: a couch can be a bed

explanation.surface: A sofa sent back before its time leaves money owing.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt is a sum owed, which must be repaid.
